sequenceDiagram autonumber participant P as Provider participant MB as Component
(NotificationBell) participant B as API
(Express + TS / NotificationController) participant DB as PostgreSQL loop Every 30 seconds (React Query refetchInterval) MB->>B: GET /api/v1/provider/notifications?limit=15 B->>DB: SELECT notifications WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 15 DB-->>B: notification rows B-->>MB: 200 { data: [...], total, unread_count } MB->>MB: update bell badge with unread_count end P->>MB: clicks bell icon MB->>P: dropdown opens — last 15 notifications opt Provider clicks a notification item P->>MB: clicks item MB->>B: PUT /api/v1/provider/notifications/:id/read B->>DB: UPDATE notifications SET read_at = NOW()\nWHERE id = ? AND user_id = ? DB-->>B: updated B-->>MB: 200 { success: true } MB->>MB: remove unread dot, decrement badge end opt Provider clicks "Đọc tất cả" P->>MB: clicks read-all button MB->>B: PUT /api/v1/provider/notifications/read-all B->>DB: UPDATE notifications SET read_at = NOW()\nWHERE user_id = ? AND read_at IS NULL DB-->>B: { updated: N } B-->>MB: 200 { success: true, updated: N } MB->>MB: clear all unread dots, badge = 0 end
